behavior: An actual onCreateInputView request with no ThemeScope sets inputViewCreationDeferred; ThemeManager readiness alone does not construct views without that request.

The existing service lifecycleScope is Main; RimeSession.runOnReady explicitly runs the block in caller thread. Ready completion checks the deferred flag after ThemeManager.init and listener registration.

Ready recovery requests replaceExisting=false: only a missing InputView or CandidatesView is constructed. Normal different-theme replacement retains its previous replace-both semantics. Successful completion clears the deferred flag.

onStartInputView records a pending start whenever InputView is absent, regardless of virtual/physical mode at that instant. Replay after registering the new view uses currentInputEditorInfo and current useVirtualKeyboard, not stale attribute/mode captured before readiness.

A fresh InputView uses default restarting=false, because all its broadcaster receivers and resident KeyboardWindow were initialized by its constructor before setInputView / InputDeviceManager registration and replay. BaseInputView.onAttachedToWindow only requests insets; it does not erase editor state.

onFinishInputView clears pending start. A hidden previously requested tree may be completed, but no showWindow, showSoftInput or forceShowSelf is introduced; it is not restarted for a finished editor.
onDestroy clears both flags before the existing lifecycle superclass cancels the coroutine and removes listeners. A destroyed service does not get a new deferred recovery job.

independent_review_iteration.finding: Sampling virtual mode at the early start could miss physical-to-touch transition before readiness.
independent_review_iteration.fix: Pending now records the missing active view start regardless of early mode; replay evaluates current mode.

scope_exclusions: No fork publication, version, signing or ABI configuration changes.
No unit tests that mirror boolean assignments; no additional Service harness/dependencies.
No Gradle, emulator, ADB, commit or push by this agent.
Existing ThemeScope deferral warning remains; this check does not establish universal zero warnings.
Base12 candidate TextView/Unicode defects are not included in this independent single-file fix.
